'''Ruby''' is a type of [[Minerals|Mineral]] obtainable by:
*[[Mining]] [[Mining#Ruby Node|Ruby Node]]s and [[Mining#Gem Node|Gem Node]]s in [[the Mines]] (Floors 80+), [[Skull Cavern]], [[Quarry]], and [[Volcano Dungeon]]. (After reaching the bottom of the Mines, Ruby Nodes can be found on any floor).
*Defeating [[Dwarvish Sentry|Dwarvish Sentries]] (10% chance).
*[[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]].
*[[Pans|Panning]] anywhere (1% chance).
*Gift at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]] by any adult except [[Clint]], [[Evelyn]], [[Marnie]], [[Robin]], or [[Willy]].
*Breaking [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|crates and barrels]] in the Mines (Floors 80+), Skull Cavern, and Volcano Dungeon.
*Found in a [[Garbage Can]] after the player has reached the bottom of the Mines.
*[[Ginger Island#Gem Birds|Gem Birds]] on [[Ginger Island|Ginger Island]] during [[Weather#Weather Types|rainy days]].

==Bundles==
Ruby is one of the options for the {{bundle|treasure hunter||y}}.

==Forging==
Ruby can be used at the [[Forge]] to increase the damage of a melee weapon.

==Recipes==
Ruby is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Ruby is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt085|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a red dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can also be placed in the red dye pot at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]], for use in [[dyeing]].

==Quests==
*The Ruby may be randomly requested during any season at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|750}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points.  The Ruby will never be requested until the player has reached floors 80+ of [[The Mines]].
*Ruby will be requested by [[Emily]] as part of the "Rock Rejuvenation" quest at the [[Quests#List_of_Special_Orders|Special Orders]] board outside Mayor [[Lewis]]' house.
*May be used in the [[Ginger Island#Gem Birds|Gem Birds]] puzzle on Ginger Island.

==Trading==
One Ruby can be traded to the [[Desert Trader]] for 1 [[Spicy Eel]].
